title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Sofia Ramos
body: Motivation: tighten KMS region residency guarantees for RBAC v2 scoped resources and improve audit logging fidelity for cross-region key selection. This change closes gaps discovered during an internal compliance review where fallback logic could select a cross-region KMS key under degraded controller conditions. Summary of changes: 1) Add explicit enforcement path in rbac/v2 policy enforcer so that any resource labeled with `kms_region_pin` must only accept keys from the pinned region; a new validation stage rejects requests that would implicitly select a cross-region key. 2) Enhance audit events to include resolved KMS key ARN, resolved region, and policy decision reason to aid post-incident forensics. 3) Harden the KMS integration: add a cached region->key mapping with TTL, surface mapping misses as high-severity audit events, and fail closed on mapping errors when the resource is marked `residency: enforced`. 4) Add unit, integration, and e2e tests for the enforcement and audit hooks, plus docs for operators on migration and rollback. Migration notes: there is a small window where controllers read both old and new enforcement flags; to minimize disruption we gate strict enforcement behind a feature flag `rbac_v2.kms_enforce_region_pin` which is enabled in this PR for main. Rollout plan: canary enable in cloud region us-west-2 for low-traffic customers, monitor audit events and error rates, then global rollout. Checklist: - [x] Design review (security & compliance) - [x] Linear: ENG-1421, PM-88 referenced - [x] Unit/integration tests added - [x] e2e on staging green - [x] Docs & operator guidance added - [x] Feature flag gated enforcement Implementation details: changes touch rbac/v2/policy_enforcer.go to add enforcement hook, audit/logging/collector.go to emit structured audit entries, kms/aws_kms.go for region validation and cached mapping, and helm chart defaults to add the feature flag. Tests: new table-driven tests for policy selection, and an integration test that simulates a missing mapping and verifies fail-closed behavior when `residency: enforced` is set. Backwards compatibility: when feature flag is disabled behavior is identical to current runtime (audit-only path). Related: ENG-1421, SEC-301, SUP-2021 (customer report).

release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2-scoped resources and add enhanced audit logging for key selection. Feature gated behind `rbac_v2.kms_enforce_region_pin` and can be canaried via helm values. See docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md for migration steps.
